Introduction: In 2026 we paired disciplined growth with deeper investment in delivery quality, security, and the communities where our teams operate.

Sections.Heading: A durable business
Sections.Body: Recurring and managed revenue reached 61 percent of total revenue. No customer represented more than seven percent of annual sales.

Sections.Heading: Responsible operations
Sections.Body: Market-based operational emissions fell 18 percent per employee, and renewable electricity coverage reached 83 percent.

Sections.Heading: People and craft
Sections.Body: We expanded technical apprenticeships, formalized principal career paths, and delivered 14,800 hours of structured learning.
